title: Abasto Shopping Mall
text: A place not so far away from my "home", but I rarely went there. The architecture of this place is fascinating tho. There are many Peruvian/ Chinese food restaurants nearby this area.

title: Homestay Block
text:
There used to be a Día supermarket here, but it closed down several weeks before the semester ended.

A little bit north to this place is a laundromat run by Valenzuela immigrant family, and a cafe run by another Valenzuela family. I've never been to the cafe but I always did my laundry here. 

A little bit further north is my home for four months. I spent my happiest time in Buenos Aires here. My host mom cooked very delicious vegetarian food for Lily, my roommate/ housemate every night, and we ate and yapped. We watched movies together, and shared our happiness and hope. It is my home on the other side of the earth.

title: 3 blocks up north
text: I sometimes came to a tiny kiosko here to get cookies. The kiosko was run by a family of Chinese immigrants, and they always greeted me with the biggest smile. They asked me where I came from and I replied, Shanghai. They told me there was another family from Shanghai nearby.

title: NYU Buenos Aires
text:
3 blocks up North and 3 blocks East
This is how I remembered my way to school, from my homestay place. 

A precious building, with an old fireplace, an elevator that can only hold one person, creaky stairs... So many memories are stored here. 

I especially LOVE the library here. Tiny as it is, it stores an immense amount of books and good reads.

title: Parque Carlos Thays
text: I went here several times for the weekend market they had. Isabella and I, on the last day of spring break, met here and enjoyed live music :"). I encountered one of my favorite songs called cancion para mi muerte.

title: Barrio Once
text:
Barrio Once, a place regarded as some of the most chaotic neighborhoods in Buenos Aires. This is a place where you can get little trinkets, materials and clothings ... the vendors are mostly immigrants from China or other places. \n\nI had a class in this neighborhood. In that class, we were asked to explore one of the blocks of this neighborhood. It felt like this place never rest.. during day time, because there were always so many vendors and people coming by, getting cheap goods from here.

I took this pic when I was having my cinema class there .. the weather wasn't the best but it was a fun area to explore ... and during that class I focused a lot on the sound in this area.
